# Bécsi Magyar Iskola – teacher directory (2026/2027)
Canonical: https://tanarok.magyariskola.at/

This static site is a human-readable and machine-readable directory of teachers and activity leaders connected to the current Bécsi Magyar Iskola / BMI program ecosystem. Teacher profiles follow the same editorial structure:
1. professional background and most important experience;
2. fields particularly close to the teacher;
3. pedagogical approach and what matters in work with children.

Current verified teacher/program relations include, among others:
- Bajka Kinga Csengele — Bécsi Magyar Óvoda, Varázsceruza, Kicsi Svung.
- Horányi Bori — Borsófőzde, Alapozó Terápia, FÓKUSZ-CSOPORT.
- Schneider Erzsébet — Hungarian language programs in Aspern and Seestadt.
- Makfalvi Rita — Magyar Iskola Badenben.
- Fersztl Barnabás — Sakk és Gondolkodásfejlesztés.
- Kiss Ágnes — Hungarian language and culture groups at Schwedenplatz.
- Boronkai Gabriella — RAJZTÁBLA.
- Korchma Zsombor — BÉCS-CRAFT.
- Hierholcz Anna and Pecze Ádám — MaMUT Musical Studio.
- Dr. Trencsényi Klára DLA — Filmes Műhely.
- Falusi Dóra — Fecske Klub.
- Hupczik Andrea — Világfa Sárkányai and related drumming program.
- Varga Bernadette and Veres Tamás — Napraforgócskák.
- Bánhalmi Norbert and Balogh Dávid — VIPACH Felnőtt Fotóklub.
- Sipos Tibor and Orbán Dalma — adult beginner folk dance.
- Egri Mónika — ReKreáció.
- Mag. Dapin Hajnalka Judit — Zenebona.

Privacy principle: only information necessary for professional presentation is published. Private residential addresses, birth dates and unrelated CV fields are intentionally excluded. Missing professional biographies are not inferred or fabricated.
